QuestInfo.name: [11th Anniversary] Share That Festive Feeling!
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p9000291# and learn about the 11th Anniversary Sharing Spirit buff.
QuestInfo.1: Use the 11th Anniversary Sharing Spirit buff on another player and report to #p9000291#.
QuestInfo.2: You learned how to share the 11th Anniversary Sharing Spirit buff with other players.

0.0: Now I'll teach you how to buff other players. Once I'm done talking, I'll give you a special item. All you have to do is use that item and the person next to you will get a buff! See? It's simple!
0.1: Now go on and share the buff!

yes.0: Don't forget, using the 11th Anniversary Sharing Spirit from your Inventory will automatically buff the person nearest to you.

no.0: It'd be even better if you could share the joy with others...

1.0: Whoa-hoh, I see you shared the festive energy with someone! Awesome.

yes.0: Hope you'll continue to share the joy with others! It's not too much of a hassle to do that, right?

default.0: Use #i2432696# #b#t2432696##k to buff the person nearest to you. Keep in mind though, you #rcan only use it once every 30 minutes#k.
